candidates.evidence: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/19262, still open on 2026-10-11 with no linked branch or pull request.
candidates.potential_agent_value: Prevent agents from following a current setup example that does not create the documented buildable project.

real_task: Determine whether current uv documentation still tells an agent to use bare uv init for a uv build-backend project and whether the current CLI artifact supports that statement.
observed_problem: An agent following the documented command may receive an application pyproject without a build-system section, contradicting the guide's stated goal.
problem_trace: Official uv issue 19262, current uv repository documentation and generated pyproject.toml artifacts.
baseline: Run bare uv init and count the build-system table and uv_build requirement in its generated pyproject.toml.
hypothesis: Current docs still show bare uv init, whose generated pyproject has zero build-system/uv_build markers, while uv init --lib produces both markers.
minimum_useful_effect: The corrected invocation improves the generated artifact from 0/2 to 2/2 while the current guide still recommends the 0/2 command.
quality_control: Pin the uv repository commit and installed uv version; use fresh empty directories; inspect exact generated pyproject.toml files; distinguish documentation inconsistency from CLI defect; make no upstream write.
overhead: Include issue read, fresh clone, availability/version check, three task commands, trace/reporting, LAB tests, site build, checkpoint refresh and publication.
stop_condition: Stop after three task-specific commands, if uv is unavailable, if either init needs network/dependency installation, or if the current docs no longer contain the disputed command. Do not patch uv, contact maintainers or build a documentation checker.
decision_reason: The current released uv binary makes the disputed bare command produce the documented uv build backend. The corrected invocation improved 2/2 to 2/2, not the predeclared 0/2 to 2/2; no documentation change or checker is justified.
limitations: The installed uv 0.12.23 binary was not built from the pinned documentation commit, so this audit establishes alignment between current main documentation and one current released binary, not every revision, platform or configuration. It does not measure agent utility, time, tokens or downstream build success.
